## Context / Problem

rebar's four-pass code-review system supports packaged criteria, while project criteria are
declared in a repository overlay. Before this epic, a net-new project code-review criterion could
be discovered by configuration but was dropped at the criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in,
Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration surface, and CLI admission. The extension contract was also
unproven in the deployed Gerrit review bot.

This epic repairs those seams, documents the contract, authors the first project criterion, and
dogfoods it in advisory-only live Gerrit reviews. It supersedes the former umbrella
`jira-reb-1001`, generic story `2c14-fa5f-1228-4e02`, and bug `8a4b-e8b6-1bf9-48d8`.

## Delivered decomposition

The eight child tickets are dependency-ordered and closed:

1. `fc72-bf7e-7652-4228` — gate-key criterion-id resolver in
   `src/rebar/llm/criteria/ids.py`.
2. `761e-5af2-ed57-408a` — Round-A fan-in and logical-id attribution in
   `src/rebar/llm/code_review/batch_runner.py` and `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py`.
3. `58ef-91fa-20c1-4f29` — repository-effective Pass-3 routing in
   `src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py`.
4. `8153-e9b5-5706-49c8` — eval/calibration admission in
   `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py` and `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py`.
5. `41e2-a0a2-2db4-4847` — CLI admission in
   `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py`.
6. `19dd-7d89-972b-4274` — runtime contract in `docs/llm-framework.md`.
7. `225a-323c-a9f6-436b` — `project.review-phase-boundaries`, routing, and balanced eval corpus.
8. `9447-b31c-e0b7-446d` — advisory live-Gerrit dogfood, including the repaired
   repository-root seam and the cleaned final prompt revision.

Each seam child owns a disjoint production-file set. The shared
`tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py` grows the end-to-end RED→GREEN proof across the
stack.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `rebar list --parent 119f-63e3-34b7-4f96` returns exactly the eight children above, each
  `closed` with a completion-verifier attestation.
- [ ] The five original drop-point categories are each owned by exactly one seam child: resolver
  (`fc72`), fan-in/attribution (`761e`), effective routing (`58ef`), eval/calibration (`8153`), and
  CLI admission (`41e2`); their production file-impact sets do not overlap.
- [ ] The no-overlay runtime preserves the ordered 13 built-ins, packaged Pass-3 dispositions, and
  default plan-review resolver mapping. Verify with
  `rtk .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit/test_code_review_project_criteria.py -k "resolver or fan_in or parity or routing"`.
- [ ] An active project code-review criterion runs once in Round A, retains its logical
  `criteria` id and physical `reviewer_id`, and uses repository-effective Pass-3 routing. Verify
  with the project-criteria unit tests and the live artifact cited on child `9447`.
- [ ] The eval/calibration API and CLI admit an active code-review-only project criterion while
  rejecting inactive or ambiguous project ids; the balanced
  `project.review-phase-boundaries` corpus and its prompt are present.
- [ ] The project-criterion runtime contract is documented in `docs/llm-framework.md`.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Child `9447-b31c-e0b7-446d` is closed with a signed completion PASS;
  its final Gerrit change is merged, its live artifact has `coverage.llm_ran: true`, the FIRE
  directive is absent from the submitted revision, and routing remains threshold `0.90` with
  blocking disabled.
- [ ] The epic has `supersedes` edges to `jira-reb-1001`, `2c14-fa5f-1228-4e02`, and
  `8a4b-e8b6-1bf9-48d8`, and all three tickets are `closed`.
